tools.name: postcode_lookup
tools.description: Looks up UK postcodes. Pass postcode to get one postcode's detailed information, matched regardless of case or spacing. Returns 404 if not found, and a terminated property if the postcode was previously active. Pass postcodes (up to 100) for a bulk lookup in one request; postcodes not found have a null result. For bulk lookups, filter limits which attributes each result includes.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: UK postcode to look up, with or without spaces, e.g. E1W1UU. Use for a single postcode.

parameters.name: postcodes
parameters.description: JSON array of up to 100 UK postcode strings for a bulk lookup, e.g. ["SW1A 1AA","M1 1AE"]. Use instead of postcode.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Comma-separated attribute names to include in each result object, for bulk lookups.

tools.name: postcode_search
tools.description: Searches UK postcodes matching a query string around a required longitude and latitude. Each result includes a distance in metres from those coordinates. Set widesearch to true for a wide area search up to 20km returning at most 10 results; this ignores radius and limit.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The search query string for postcodes.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude, a WGS84 value between -180 and 180.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude, a WGS84 value between -90 and 90.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return, max 100.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in metres, max 2000.

parameters.name: widesearch
parameters.description: true for a wide area search up to 20km returning at most 10 results; ignores radius and limit.

tools.name: postcode_nearest
tools.description: Finds UK postcodes nearest to a given postcode, ordered by distance. Returns 404 if the input postcode is not found.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: The postcode to search from, e.g. E1W1UU.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of postcodes to return, max 100.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in metres, max 2000.

tools.name: postcode_autocomplete
tools.description: Lists UK postcodes matching a partial postcode, for suggesting completions while a postcode is being typed.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: The partial postcode to match.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of postcode matches to return, must be less than 100.

tools.name: random_postcode
tools.description: Returns a random UK postcode with all its available data. Optionally pass outcode to pick a random postcode from that outcode; an invalid outcode returns null.

parameters.name: outcode
parameters.description: Outcode to filter random postcodes by, e.g. CM8 or SW1.

tools.name: terminated_postcode_lookup
tools.description: Looks up a terminated UK postcode, one that is no longer in use. Matches input with or without the space and in any letter case. Returns 404 if not found.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: The terminated UK postcode, e.g. E1W1UU.

tools.name: scottish_postcode_lookup
tools.description: Looks up the Scottish Postcode Directory record for a Scottish postcode. Returns 404 if the postcode is not in the SPD; a 404 with the message Postcode exists in ONSPD but not in SPD means it is only in ONSPD.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: The Scottish postcode, e.g. AB101XG.

tools.name: outcode_lookup
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a UK outward code, the first half of a postcode. Matching is case-insensitive. Returns 404 if the outward code is not found.

parameters.name: outcode
parameters.description: UK outward code, the first half of a postcode, e.g. BR8.

tools.name: outcode_nearest
tools.description: Finds UK outcodes nearest to an outcode, or nearest to a longitude and latitude pair, ordered by proximity. Pass outcode to find its neighbours (404 if not found). Pass lon and lat to find outcodes nearest to coordinates; these results have the same shape as an outcode lookup.

parameters.name: outcode
parameters.description: The outcode to find neighbours of, e.g. NW1. Use instead of lon and lat.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude, a WGS84 value between -180 and 180. Use together with lat.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude, a WGS84 value between -90 and 90. Use together with lon.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of outcodes returned, max 100.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in metres, max 25000.

tools.name: place_lookup
tools.description: Looks up GB places. Pass code to get one place by its OSGB code; returns 404 if not found. Pass q to search places by name: full-text match on primary and secondary names, falling back to prefix matching, returning an empty array or up to 100 places.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: OSGB code of the place, e.g. osgb4000000074564391. Use instead of q.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The search query string matched against place names. Use instead of code.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of search results to return, max 100.

tools.name: random_place
tools.description: Returns a random GB place with all its data. Takes no arguments.
